blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Accurate brain tumor segmentation from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is essential for diagnosis, treatment planning, and surgical guidance. Although Convolutional Neural Networks (CNNs), particularly U-Net, have achieved significant success in medical image segmentation, they often struggle to capture the long-range spatial dependencies required to model tumors with irregular shapes and complex boundaries. This paper proposes a lightweight Vision Transformer U-Net (ViT-UNet) that combines the hierarchical feature extraction capability of U-Net with the global context modeling of Vision Transformers. The proposed architecture incorporates a compact ViT bottleneck within a U-Net encoder-decoder framework, enabling effective learning of both local and global features while maintaining computational efficiency with only 2.6 million trainable parameters. The model was evaluated on the TCGA-LGG MRI Segmentation dataset, achieving a mean Intersection over Union (IoU) of 0.8100 and a Dice score of 0.8446, outperforming the baseline U-Net by 3.75% and 3.15%, respectively. Extensive quantitative and qualitative analyses, including confusion matrix evaluation, precision–recall curves, per-image performance distribution, and tumor-size dependency analysis, demonstrate the effectiveness and robustness of the proposed method for brain tumor segmentation.
blocks.zh: 磁共振成像(MRI)的精确脑瘤分化对于诊断、治疗规划和手术指导至关重要。 虽然革命神经网络(CNNs),特别是U-Net在医学图像分解上取得了显著成功,但它们常常努力捕捉到以不规则形状和复杂边界模拟肿瘤所需的远距离空间依赖性. 本文提出轻量级ViT-UNet变换器U-Net(ViT-UNet),将U-Net的分级特征提取能力与视觉变换器的全球环境模型化相结合. 拟议的架构将一个紧凑的ViT瓶颈纳入U-Net编码器-解码器框架内,从而能够有效学习当地和全球特点,同时保持计算效率,只有260万个可培训参数。 该模型在TCGA-LGG核磁共振分解数据集上进行了评价,在联盟上空实现了0.8100的中间分解,二分数为0.8446,分别比基线U-Net高出3.75%和3.15%。 广泛的定量和定性分析,包括混乱矩阵评估、精确-召回曲线、每个图像的性能分布以及肿瘤大小依赖性分析,都显示了拟议的脑瘤分化方法的有效性和强性。

blocks.en: I Introduction
blocks.zh: 一. 导言

blocks.en:
Brain tumors are among the most life-threatening neurological diseases, and accurate segmentation from Magnetic Resonance Imaging (MRI) is important for diagnosis and treatment planning [1]. However, manual tumor delineation is time-consuming and subjective, motivating the development of automated segmentation methods [2].
U-Net and its variants have achieved strong performance in medical image segmentation through encoder-decoder architectures with skip connections [3]. However, CNNs mainly capture local spatial features and may have limited ability to model long-range dependencies, particularly for tumors with irregular shapes and ambiguous boundaries [4]. Vision Transformers (ViTs) address this limitation through self-attention and global contextual modeling [5]. However, existing hybrid CNN-Transformer architectures, such as TransUNet, Swin-UNet, UNETR, and VT-UNet, can introduce considerable computational and parameter overhead [6], [7].
To address this limitation, we propose a lightweight ViT-UNet that combines CNN-based local feature extraction with global contextual modeling through a compact Vision Transformer bottleneck. Unlike architectures that use Transformer modules extensively throughout the network, our approach applies the Transformer only at the bottleneck, using two self-attention blocks with four heads. This design maintains a compact model size of approximately 2.6 million parameters while providing an effective balance between segmentation performance and computational efficiency.
The main contributions of this work are: 1. A compact hybrid ViT-UNet architecture that integrates a shallow Vision Transformer exclusively at the U-Net bottleneck to capture global contextual dependencies while retaining convolution-based hierarchical feature extraction. 2. A lightweight Vision Transformer bottleneck consisting of two self-attention blocks with four attention heads, designed to introduce global context with limited additional computational and parameter overhead. 3. A hybrid segmentation framework combining the proposed Transformer bottleneck with the U-Net encoder-decoder and hybrid loss formulation, enabling complementary modeling of local boundaries and global tumor context. 4. Comprehensive evaluation using quantitative metrics, qualitative segmentation analysis, ablation experiments, and comparison with the baseline U-Net and existing hybrid segmentation approaches. 5. The proposed model achieves a mean Intersection over Union (IoU) of 0.8100 and a Dice score of 0.8446 on the TCGA-LGG MRI segmentation dataset. The remainder of this paper is organized as follows. Section II reviews related work; Section III presents the proposed methodology; Section IV describes the experimental results; Section V discusses the findings and limitations; and Section VI concludes the paper.
blocks.zh:
脑瘤属于最威胁生命的神经病,磁共振成像(MRI)的准确分化对于诊断和治疗规划很重要[1]. 然而,人工肿瘤的划定既费时又主观,激发了自动化分解方法的发展[2].
U-Net及其变体通过有跳转连接的编码器-解码器架构[3],在医学图像分解中取得了强大的性能. 然而,CNN主要捕捉到当地的空间特征,可能具有有限的能力来建模远程依赖性,特别是对于形状不规则,界限模糊的肿瘤[4]. 愿景变换器(ViTs)通过自我关注和全球背景模型处理这一局限性[5]. 然而,现有的混合式CNN-Transformer架构,如TransUNet,Swin-UNet,UNETR,和VT-UNet,可以引入相当的计算和参数的间接费用[6],[7].
为了克服这一限制,我们提议采用一个轻量级的Vit-UNet,通过紧凑的Vision Transformer瓶颈,将基于CNN的本地特色提取与全球背景模型相结合。 与在整个网络中广泛使用变形器模块的架构不同,我们的方法只在瓶颈处应用变形器,使用两个带有四个头的自动块. 这种设计保持了约260万参数的紧凑模型尺寸,同时在分割性能和计算效率之间提供了有效的平衡.
这项工作的主要贡献是: 1. 紧凑的混合式ViT-UNet架构,将一个浅浅的Visual Transformer专门装在U-Net的瓶颈,以捕捉全球背景依赖性,同时保留基于演化的等级特征提取. 2. 轻量级视觉变形器瓶颈,由两个自留心区块组成,四个注意头,旨在引入全球背景,增加有限的计算和参数间接费用。 3. 混合分解框架,将拟议的变形器瓶颈与U-Net编码器-解码器和混合损失配方结合起来,使当地边界和全球肿瘤环境能够形成互补模型。 4. 采用定量计量、定性分解分析、消蚀实验以及与基线U-Net和现有混合分解方法进行比较的综合评价。 5. 拟议的模型在TCGA-LGG磁共振分解数据集上实现0.8100的中间交叉和0.8446的双极分数。 本文件的其余部分编排如下。 第二节审查有关工作;第三节提出拟议方法;第四节说明试验结果;第五节讨论调查结果和局限性;第六节结束本文件。

blocks.en: II Related Work
blocks.zh: 二. 相关工作

blocks.en: This section reviews representative studies on brain tumor segmentation using CNNs, Vision Transformers, and hybrid architectures, with emphasis on the trade-off between segmentation performance and computational complexity.
blocks.zh: 本节审查利用CNNs,Vision Transformers,以及混合结构对脑瘤分解进行的代表性研究,强调分解性能与计算复杂性之间的权衡.

blocks.en: II-A U-Net and CNN-based Segmentation
blocks.zh: II-A U-Net和CNN的分区

blocks.en: U-Net, introduced by Ronneberger et al. [3], uses an encoder-decoder architecture with skip connections and has become a widely used framework for medical image segmentation. Several variants, including 3D U-Net [8], Attention U-Net [9], and nnU-Net [10], have further improved segmentation performance. However, CNN-based models primarily rely on local convolutional operations and may have difficulty modeling long-range spatial dependencies, particularly for tumors with irregular shapes and ambiguous boundaries.
blocks.zh: U-Net,由Ronneberger等人介绍. [3],使用带有跳过连接的编码器-解码器架构,并已成为医疗图像分割的广泛使用框架. 包括3D U-Net [8],注意U-Net [9],和nnU-Net [10]在内的几个变体进一步提高了分块性能. 然而,基于CNN的模型主要依靠局部的演化操作,可能难以对长程空间依赖性进行建模,尤其是对于形状不规则,界限模糊的肿瘤而言.

blocks.en: II-B Vision Transformers in Medical Imaging
blocks.zh: II-B 医疗成像中的视觉变形器

blocks.en:
Vision Transformers (ViTs) use self-attention to model long-range dependencies and global contextual information [5], [11]. Hybrid architectures such as TransUNet [6], Swin-UNet [7], and VT-UNet [12] combine Transformer-based global modeling with U-Net-style feature extraction and decoding. Although these approaches provide effective contextual representation, their relatively large Transformer components can increase the number of parameters and computational requirements.
In contrast, the proposed ViT-UNet uses a compact Vision Transformer only at the U-Net bottleneck rather than employing Transformer modules throughout the network. This design retains CNN-based local feature extraction while introducing global contextual modeling at a reduced spatial resolution. The proposed bottleneck uses two self-attention blocks with four attention heads and contributes to a total model size of approximately 2.6 million parameters.
blocks.zh:
Vision Transformers(ViTs)使用自我关注来模拟远程依赖和全球背景信息[5],[11]. TransUNet[6],Swin-UNet[7],VT-UNet[12]等混合建筑将基于变形器的全球模型与U-Net风格的特征提取和解码相结合. 虽然这些方法提供了有效的背景代表,但其相对较大的变形器组件可以增加参数的数量和计算要求.
相比之下,拟议的VIT-UNet只在U-Net瓶颈使用紧凑的Vision变形器,而不是在整个网络中使用变形器模块. 这种设计保留了基于CNN的局部特征提取,同时以较低的空间分辨率引入全球背景模型. 拟议的瓶颈采用两个自留式块,有四个注意头,有助于模型总大小约260万个参数.

blocks.en: II-C Brain Tumor Segmentation
blocks.zh: II-C 脑肿瘤分裂

blocks.en: The BraTS challenges have established widely used benchmarks for brain tumor segmentation [13], [14]. In this work, the TCGA-LGG dataset is used to evaluate binary tumor segmentation for lower-grade glioma cases. The objective is to develop a lightweight segmentation framework that can capture both local tumor features and global contextual information while maintaining a compact model size.
blocks.zh: BrATS的挑战为脑瘤分化建立了广泛使用的基准[13],[14]. 在这项工作中,TCGA-LGG数据集被用于评价低级胶原体病例的二进制肿瘤分化. 目标是开发一个轻量级分解框架,既能捕捉局部肿瘤特征,又能捕捉全球背景信息,同时保持紧凑的模型尺寸.

blocks.en: III Methodology
blocks.zh: 三、结 论 方法

blocks.en: To enhance brain tumor segmentation, the proposed method is based on the ViT-UNet, which incorporates a lightweight Vision Transformer (ViT) bottleneck in the U-Net. This section outlines the preparation of the dataset, the network architecture, the loss function, the training procedure and the evaluation metrics.
blocks.zh: 为加强脑瘤分化,拟议方法以Vit-UNet为基础,在U-Net中加入了轻量级视觉变形器(ViT)瓶颈. 本节概述数据集,网络架构,损失功能,培训程序和评价衡量标准的编制情况.

blocks.en: III-A Dataset and Preprocessing
blocks.zh: 数据集和预处理

blocks.en: We use the TCGA-LGG MRI Segmentation dataset which contains MRI scans and corresponding binary tumor masks from 110 patients. Each of them is in TIF format consisting of slices in all three directions of (axial, coronal, sagittal). and all available slices were used for training.
blocks.zh: 我们使用TCGA-LGG核磁共振分解数据集 包含110个病人的核磁共振扫描和相应的二进制肿瘤口罩。 每个都采用TIF格式,由所有三个方向(轴,冠,agi)的切片组成. 所有可用的切片都用于培训。

blocks.en: III-B Model Architecture
blocks.zh: 三-B 示范建筑

blocks.en: The proposed ViT-UNet integrates a U-Net encoder-decoder with a Vision Transformer (ViT) bottleneck, as shown in Fig. 2 .
blocks.zh: 如图2所示,拟议的VIT-UNet将一个U-Net编码器-解码器与一个视觉变形器(ViT)瓶颈融合在一起。

blocks.en: Fig. 2: Proposed ViT-UNet architecture. The encoder extracts hierarchical features, the ViT bottleneck captures global context, and the decoder reconstructs the segmentation map using skip connections.
blocks.zh: 费格。 2:拟议VIT-UNet架构. 编码器提取等级特征,ViT瓶颈抓住全局背景,解码器利用跳过连接重建分区图.

blocks.en:
Encoder: The hierarchical features are extracted using max-pooling, whereas feature channel (32–256) is increased in four DoubleConv blocks with batch normalization and ReLU. ViT Bottleneck: To obtain global contextual information from the deepest feature representation, a lightweight Vision Transformer consisting of two blocks of self-attention with 4 heads is used. Decoder: A number of transposed convolutions and skip connections are used to focus on recovering the original spatial resolution, then followed by a 1 × 1 1\times 1 convolution to produce the binary segmentation mask.
The proposed network is composed of about 2.6 million trainable parameters keeping the complexity and accuracy in a balance.

blocks.en: The AdamW optimizer was used to optimize the model, and learning rate was scheduled using cosine annealer with k=22. All experiments were implemented in PyTorch and executed on a 12GB NVIDIA GPU with CUDA support.

blocks.en: V Discussion
blocks.zh: 五. 讨论情况

blocks.en: Evaluation of the proposed architecture, interpretation of the experiment results and suggestions for future research and limitations of this study are addressed.
blocks.zh: 报告讨论了拟议架构的评价、对实验结果的解释以及今后研究的建议和这项研究的局限性。

blocks.en: V-A Performance Interpretation
blocks.zh: V-A 业绩解释

blocks.en: The proposed ViT-UNet achieved a mean IoU of 0.8100 and a Dice score of 0.8446, demonstrating promising brain tumor segmentation performance. The model achieved high specificity (99.73%) and a sensitivity of 82.6%, indicating effective tumor detection while maintaining a low false-positive rate. Further investigation will focus on multimodal MRI data and improved learning strategies to enhance segmentation performance and generalizability.
blocks.zh: 拟议的VIT-UNet实现了0.8100的中间IoU和0.8446的Dice分数,显示出有希望的脑瘤分解性能. 该模型实现了高特异性(99.73%)和82.6%的灵敏度,表明在保持低假阳性率的同时,有效检测肿瘤. 进一步调查将侧重于多式联运磁共振数据和改进学习战略,以提高分化性能和普遍性。

blocks.en: V-B Limitations and Future Work
blocks.zh: 限制和未来的工作

blocks.en: Despite the promising performance of the proposed model, this study has several limitations. The model was evaluated on a relatively small LGG dataset using single-modality 2D MRI images, which may limit its generalizability across different datasets, MRI modalities, and acquisition protocols. Future work will focus on evaluation using larger and more diverse datasets, multimodal and 3D segmentation, explainable AI, and real-time optimization to further improve the model’s robustness and practical applicability.
blocks.zh: 尽管拟议模式的业绩令人乐观,但本研究有几种局限性。 该模型在使用单式二维磁共振图像的相对小型LGG数据集上得到了评价,这可能限制其在不同数据集、磁共振模式和获取协议中的通用性。 今后的工作将侧重于利用更大、更多样化的数据集、多式联运和三维分解、可解释的人工智能以及实时优化评估,以进一步提高模型的稳健性和实用性。

blocks.en: VI Conclusion
blocks.zh: 六 结论

blocks.en: This paper presented a lightweight brain tumor segmentation model based on a Vision Transformer (ViT) bottleneck incorporated into a U-Net architecture. The proposed model combines CNN-based local feature extraction with Transformer-based global contextual modeling while maintaining a compact size of approximately 2.6 million parameters. Experiments on the TCGA-LGG MRI segmentation dataset achieved an IoU of 0.8100 and a Dice score of 0.8446, outperforming the baseline U-Net. These results demonstrate the potential of the proposed architecture for accurate and computationally efficient brain tumor segmentation. Future work will investigate multimodal and 3D MRI segmentation, model explainability, and validation on larger and more diverse datasets.
blocks.zh: 本文介绍了一种轻量级脑瘤分解模型,其基础是纳入U-Net架构的Vision Transformer(ViT)瓶颈. 拟议模型将基于CNN的局部特征提取与基于变形器的全球性背景模型结合,同时保持约260万个参数的紧凑大小. TCGA-LGG磁共振分解数据集上的实验实现了0.8100的IoU和0.8446的Dice分数,超过了基线U-Net. 这些结果表明,拟议架构具有准确和计算高效的脑瘤分化潜力。 今后的工作将调查多式和三维磁共振分解、模型解释性以及对更大和更多样化数据集的验证。
